title: Beyond Reward Scoring: Online Multi-Agent Preference Learning for Multimodal Response Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.23256v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal preference alignment often follows a score-based RLHF pipeline: a reward model is first trained to learn human preferences, then used to score on-policy responses and optimize the response model's generation. This turns preference supervision into a scalar signal for generation: a model may learn to produce answers with higher preference scores, but is rarely trained explicitly to learn the reasons underlying human preferences. We therefore ask whether making preference understanding an internal capability of the response model can improve its generation. To investigate this question, we propose \textbf{PrefMind}, an online dual-agent reinforcement learning framework with two trainable agents: a response Generator and a preference Critic. translated_title: 超越奖励评分：面向多模态响应生成的在线多智能体偏好学习
translated_abstract: 多模态偏好对齐通常遵循基于评分的RLHF流程：首先训练一个奖励模型来学习人类偏好，然后用它对在线策略生成的响应进行评分，并优化响应模型的生成。这种做法将偏好监督转化为用于生成优化的标量信号：模型可能学会生成具有更高偏好分数的答案，但很少被显式训练去学习人类偏好背后的原因。因此，我们提出疑问：将偏好理解作为响应模型的内部能力，能否改善其生成效果。为了研究这一问题，我们提出了PrefMind，一个在线双智能体强化学习框架，包含两个可训练的智能体：响应生成器和偏好评论家。给定一对候选响应，两个智能体会分析并讨论哪个响应更符合人类偏好，人类标注则用于监督它们的判断和修正。（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出PrefMind在线双智能体强化学习框架，通过响应生成器与偏好评论家的分析讨论和人类标注监督，让模型将偏好理解内化为自身能力，从而超越传统奖励评分方式改进多模态响应生成。
en_tdlr: PrefMind, an online dual-agent reinforcement learning framework with a response Generator and a preference Critic supervised by human labels, internalizes preference understanding as a model capability to improve multimodal response generation beyond scalar reward scoring.
